q: 妈妈___做饭，你先看电视吧。
en: Mum is cooking, so watch TV for now.

q: 爸爸现在___看报纸。
en: Dad is reading the newspaper now.

q: 哥哥也___洗车。
en: My older brother is washing the car too.

q: 他们都___准备搬家。
en: They are all getting ready to move house.

q: 我弟弟正___写作业，别吵他。
en: My younger brother is doing his homework, don't bother him.

q: 路上很堵，司机们都___按喇叭。
en: The road is jammed and the drivers are all honking their horns.

q: 我听见楼上的邻居___搬家具，吵得我睡不着。
en: I can hear the upstairs neighbour moving furniture, and the noise keeps me awake.

q: 我们俩都___等对方先开口，所以谁也没说话。
en: We were both waiting for the other to speak first, so neither of us said anything.

q: 你小声点，宝宝睡觉___。
en: Keep it down, the baby is sleeping.

q: 别关电视，爸爸看新闻___。
en: Don't turn off the TV, Dad is watching the news.

q: 妹妹在厨房洗菜___。
en: My younger sister is washing vegetables in the kitchen.

q: 你先别进去，他们正在开会___。
en: Don't go in yet, they're in a meeting right now.

q: 等一下，我正在找钥匙___，马上就好。
en: Hang on, I'm looking for my keys, it'll be a moment.

q: 孩子们还在楼下玩___，还没回来。
en: The kids are still playing downstairs, they haven't come back.

q: 你不用打电话了，奶奶和爷爷正在公园里散步___，晚点儿就回来。
en: No need to call, Grandma and Grandpa are out for a walk in the park, they'll be back later.

q: 我___在看电视，我在看书。
en: I'm not watching TV, I'm reading.

q: 弟弟___在睡觉，他在玩游戏。
en: My younger brother isn't sleeping, he's playing a game.

q: 你在做饭吗？___，我在洗衣服。
en: Are you cooking? No, I'm washing clothes.

q: 爸爸___在客厅看电视，他在书房工作。
en: Dad isn't watching TV in the living room, he's working in the study.

q: 我们___在排队买票，我们刚到。
en: We aren't queuing for tickets, we've just arrived.

q: 你是不是在玩手机？___，我在查地图。
en: Are you playing on your phone? No, I'm checking the map.

q: 你别以为我在偷懒，我___在休息，我在想怎么修这台洗衣机。
en: Don't think I'm slacking off, I'm not resting, I'm thinking about how to fix this washing machine.

q: 昨天你打电话的时候，我___洗澡。
en: When you called yesterday, I was in the shower.

q: 昨天晚上八点，妈妈___做饭。
en: At eight last night Mum was cooking.

q: 明天晚上七点我___开会，不能接电话。
en: I'll be in a meeting at seven tomorrow evening, so I can't answer the phone.

q: 我给你打电话的时候，你___在做什么？
en: What were you doing when I called you?

q: 地铁到站的时候，很多人___站台上等车。
en: When the train pulled in, a lot of people were waiting on the platform.

q: 昨天警察来的时候，邻居们都___院子里聊天。
en: When the police came yesterday, the neighbours were all chatting in the yard.

q: 我们昨天到的时候，他们已经___吃饭了，所以我们没打扰他们。
en: When we arrived yesterday they were already eating, so we didn't disturb them.

q: 奶奶一直___等你，快去看看她吧。
en: Grandma has been waiting for you all along, go and see her.

q: 已经十点了，哥哥还___睡觉。
en: It's already ten and my older brother is still sleeping.

q: 我妹妹总是___玩手机，不爱看书。
en: My younger sister is always on her phone and doesn't like reading.

q: 爷爷每天早上都___打太极拳。
en: Grandpa is out doing tai chi every morning.

q: 你怎么还___睡？太阳都出来了。
en: How come you're still asleep? The sun is already up.

q: 他经常___想回老家，因为他很想念父母。
en: He often finds himself thinking about going back to his hometown, because he misses his parents.

q: 我从早上到现在一直___找那家饭馆，可是还没找到。
en: I've been looking for that restaurant from the morning until now, and I still haven't found it.

q: 妈妈不___家，她去超市了。
en: Mum isn't at home, she's gone to the supermarket.

q: 奶奶___公园里散步。
en: Grandma is walking in the park.

q: 我哥哥___图书馆学习。
en: My older brother is studying in the library.

q: 李老师___在办公室，你去楼下的教室找她。
en: Teacher Li isn't in the office, go and look for her in the classroom downstairs.

q: 他___教室里等你，你快去吧。
en: He's waiting for you in the classroom right now, so hurry.

q: 孩子们都___小区的花园里踢球，只有小王一个人在家写作业。
en: The kids are all out playing football in the neighbourhood garden, only Xiao Wang is at home doing homework.

q: 我昨天到家的时候，爸爸不___家，他在楼下的超市买东西。
en: When I got home yesterday Dad wasn't there, he was at the supermarket downstairs buying things.

q: 我___知道他的电话号码。
en: I know his phone number.

q: 弟弟___喜欢这只小猫。
en: My younger brother likes this kitten.

q: 我们家___有三个房间。
en: Our home has three rooms.

q: 他现在___是我们班的班长。
en: He is our class monitor now.

q: 我___觉得这个房子太小了，不太适合我们住。
en: I think this flat is too small and doesn't really suit us.

q: 我不___知道楼下新搬来的邻居是做什么工作的，只听说他很有钱。
en: I don't know what the new neighbour downstairs does for a living, I only heard he is rich.

q: 我正在写___作业，别跟我说话。
en: I'm doing my homework, don't talk to me.

q: 爸爸在洗___碗，你去帮他吧。
en: Dad is washing the dishes, go and help him.

q: 我在看___一部电影，你别关电视。
en: I'm watching a film, don't turn off the TV.

q: 孩子们正在做___作业，还没做完。
en: The kids are doing their homework and haven't finished yet.

q: 我等___你一个小时了，你怎么才来？
en: I've been waiting for you for an hour, why are you only just here?

q: 他陪奶奶在医院住___三天了，现在还没回家。
en: He has been staying at the hospital with Grandma for three days and still hasn't come home.
